title: Addressing People: Tú, Usted and Vos
goal: Choose between tú and usted, use don and doña, and recognise vos.
grammar: Addressing People: Tú, Usted and Vos

items: I can choose between *tú* and *usted* for the person I am talking to.
I can use *don*, *doña*, *señor* and *señora* to address someone with respect.
I can recognise *vos* and its present forms, as used in Argentina and Uruguay.
